comment_regular: Verified REFR parser reads XLOD as a 12-byte distant-data normal vector, DATA as six floats (first three base position, last three rotationAnglesXYZ radians), and XSCL as scale. XLOD components are remapped/capped and added to the rounded DATA position. Output scalePercentWithFloorBias is floor(XSCL*100)+0.97; downstream floors/divides by100. Rotation components are applied in X, Y, Z order.
